stem.text: A student makes a sound at point R near a building. A second student, standing at point S around the corner of the building, hears the sound. The building is a solid structure and there are no other structures nearby.

stem.alt: Diagram of a rectangular building with the labels building, R and S, showing points R and S with a student drawn at each point.

stem.text: Which effect best explains how the student at point S is able to hear the student at point R?
